title: I made an app where your logged workouts turn into points for your character
author: ssj4gogeta78
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'd love to get some feedback on a project I've been working on.

I'm very new to app and game development, but over the past few months I've been building an iOS workout tracker, and about a month ago I decided to gamify the entire experience. The app is called Swole Streets (available for free on the iOS App Store).

I drew a lot of inspiration from games like Castle Crashers and Super Mario Bros, as well as anime like Solo Leveling. I created basically all of the art myself, and relied heavily on Codex to build out the coding and core mechanics.

Every time you log a workout (weight training, stretching, sports, etc.), you earn 1 Stat Point. You can assign points to Health, Damage, Magic, Speed, or Special Ability (capped at 3 points per day). Reaching workout milestones levels up your character, giving a +1 boost to all stats.

Questions that could help me:

1. Do you think the hybrid "retro workout tracker + arcade game" model works as something to play between sets or just in spare time, or would it be better to split them up and focus purely on the game?
2. Is the concept engaging enough to keep you motivated to log daily workouts?
3. Does the game seem too simple? Like should the art be more captivating, or is sometimes simple better?

I'd love to hear your thoughts, critical feedback, or ideas on what to do with this concept.
